rites.name: Ukanamira
rites.text: Ukanamira is the concept of the Singing in Silemuarora, the undated sounding that drew the first roots of the world into condensed form during the Age of Sundering. It names the moment when landfall broke the old bonds between the drifting shores and the deep tides.

rites.name: Kornak
rites.text: Kornak is a concept within Silemuarora, the resonance a world hums as its first roots set during the Singing, before any calendar held the years. It is the quiet pulse that lets landfall tear old bonds apart in the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Ryirys
rites.text: Ryirys is a concept of the Arcane Realm of Silemuarora, a principle of walls and their keeping that took shape in the Walled Age, when orders and churches first raised holding walls against the wild. Its dominion grew through the Age of the first sovereign, as groves gave way to kingdoms and the first crossings were made between them.

rites.name: Sivseth
rites.text: Sivseth is the concept of the sealed rite by which the Walled Orders of Silemuarora bound a flame to a single hearth. Its doctrine holds that a flame kept within walls is a flame that cannot consume the city, and its keepers measure every age by how long the wall has held.

rites.name: Elaennaleth
rites.text: Elaennaleth is a dormant weave of pollen-light and root-song that stirs only when the Silemuarora forests are listened to. Its wakings are rare and brief, since the tangle of living bonds it draws on must be rebuilt each time from the grove that answers it.

rites.name: Mianerleth
rites.text: Mianerleth is a tide-sung bloom of living lightning that the Silemuarora's river-wardens coax from the roots of storm-drowned forests. It is less a creature than a weather that has agreed to answer a name, and it grows louder the longer its keeper stays faithful to the land.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a woven lattice of pale green light that exists only where living roots meet silver thread in the Silemuarora's arcane groves. It is less a creature than a standing covenant between a summoner and the wild, growing stronger the more the land itself consents to its presence.
